sources.title: GPT‑5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
sources.snippet: As model capabilities increase, we strengthen our safety stack so advanced intelligence can remain broadly useful while applying greater scrutiny to the highest-risk uses. For GPT‑5.6, we built our most robust safety system to date, calibrated to each model's capabilities and powered by more compute than ever before.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro | Google's Most Advanced AI Model 2026
sources.snippet: Gemini 3.1 Pro is Google DeepMind's most advanced AI model, released on February 19, 2026. It delivers a 2x+ reasoning boost over Gemini 3 Pro, ranks #1 on 12 of 18 tracked benchmarks, and supports 1M token context with 65K token output.
